content: Ammanon Duus Woykko Woga Naago
Intteno yuushshi qoppontta Galatiya asatoo! Inttes balettontta mala iza kaqeteththaa ta intte sinththan misle mala giigsa bessadisko shin inttena oonee bitiday?
Intte Xillo Ayana ekkiday woga naagoneyee? Sabbakettida qaala ammanonee? Ta hanno issiniyo inttefe erana koyays.
Intte hessa mala qoppi erontta asee? Xoossa Ayanan oykkidayssa zaaridi asho hanon polanaas waayetteetii?
Tumu intte hanno gakkanaas daaburda daabursay coo melaa? Coo mela gidikko hada daaburdeta.
Xoossi inttes Ayana immidaynne intte achchan malaata ooththiday intte woga naagida gishshasseyee? Woykko intte siyida qaalaan ammanida gishshasseyee?
Ane intte Abrahaame gishshas qopite; geeshsha Maxaafan, «Izi Xoos ammaniin ammanoy izas xilloteththan qoodettides» geetetti xaafettides.
Hessa gishshas ammanizayti Abrahaame nayta gididayssa wozinan woththite.
Ayzaabey ammanon attanayssa eridi Xoossi kase Geeshsha Maxaafan, «Derey wuri ne baggara anjjettana» giidi Mishiraachcho qaalaa Abrahaames yooti woththides.
Hessa gishshas ammanizayti wuri ammaniza Abrahaamera issife anjjettidayta.
«Woga naagon ammanettizayti wurikka qanggeththa garsan deettes; woga maxaafatan xaafettidayssa ubbaa ooththonttaadey izi qanggettidaade» geetetti xaafettides.
«Xillo asi ammanon de7ees» giza gishshas oonikka Xoossa sinththan wogan attonttayssi geeshsha.
Wogay ammanon xaphibeenna; gido attiin, «Wogata wursi naagizaadey izi naagidayssan de7on daana» geetettides.
«Miththa bolla kaqettiza asi qanggettidaade» geetetti xaafettida gishshas Kirstoosi nu gishshas qanggettidaade gididi nuna woga qanggeththafe wozzides.
Abrahaames imettida anjjoy Yesus Kirstoosa baggara deres gakkana mala nuna wozzides; hessika nuni ammanon Xillo Ayana ekkana mala hanides.
Woganne Hidota Qaala

Ta ishatoo! Ane ta inttes asi ba duussan haniza miish leemiso immays; haray attoshin asi issito caaqqida qaala issito caaqqidaappe guye oonikka shaaranaas woykko hara iza bolla gujjana dandayonttayssa mala hayssika hessa mala.

Xoossi Abrahaames yootida qaalay Abrahaamessinne iza zereththassa; Geeshsha Maxaafay daro asas yootiza mala, «Iza zereththatas» geenna; gido attiin issi asas yootettiza mala, «Ne zereththas» gees; hessika Kirstoosa.
Ta gizaykka hayssa; 430 layththafe guyen imettida wogay kasetidi Xoossi minththida caaqoza laallidi buro hanana hidota qaalaa shaarenna.
Laatay wogan hanizaakko hidota qaalan gelanaas koshshennashin; Xoossi ba kiyateththa qaalan Abrahaames immides.

Histtiin wogay aazas imettidee? Wogay imettiday asay woga yedhdhi aadhdhiza gishshas he ufayssay bessiza zereththay yaana gakkanaassa; wogay yidaykka kiitanchchata baggara gaanna gidiza issaade baggara yides.
Gidikkoka gaannazi issaa bagga xalla xeellizaade gidenna; Xoossi gidikko issaa xalla.
Histtiin wogay sinththafe Xoossi woththana qaalaa diggizaazee? Mulekka diggenna; wogay imettiday asi izan de7o demmanaas gididaakko tumukka xilloteththi woga baggara beettanakkoshin.
Qasse Geeshsha Maxaafay hayssi alamey wurikka nagaran qashettidayssa awajjees; hessika asi wurikka Yesus Kirstoosa ammanon beettiza hidotay ammanizaytas ubbaas imettanaassa.
Hayssi ammanoy yaanaappe kase nuni wogan qashettidi gordan doos.
Hessa gishshas nu ammanon xillana mala wogay nuna Kirstoosakko gaththanaas naagizaade mala gididi naagides.
Ha7i qasse he ammanoy yida gishshas hayssafe guye nuni woga garsan dookko.
Xoossa Nayta
Intte wurikka Yesus Kirstoosa ammanon Xoossa nayta.
Intte Kirstoosara issino gidanaas xammaqettidayti wurikka Kirstoosa may7o mala may7ideta.
Intte wurikka Yesus Kirstoosan issino attiin Ayhudanne Girike, Ayllenne goqa, maccanne adde giza dummateththi deenna; intte wurikka Yesus Kirstoosan issino.
Intte Kirstoosayta gidikko intte Abrahaame zereththata; kase imettida hidota qaalaa mala intte laattanayta.
